text.id: Malam itu gue balik ke tembok laut Pluit. Bawa dua gelas es teh, kebiasaan yang ternyata nggak hilang.
text.en: That night I go back to the Pluit seawall. With two cups of iced tea, a habit that turns out not to have gone anywhere.

text.id: Gue buka chat yang ada nama gue di HP Sekar. Draf-draf yang nggak pernah kekirim. Maret. Juni. Agustus. Voice note dua puluh detik yang nyuruh gue mulai.
text.en: I open the chat with my name on it on Sekar's phone. The drafts she never sent. March. June. August. The twenty-second voice note that told me to start.

text.id: Nol lima tiga nol. Jempol gue udah hafal tanpa mikir.
text.en: Zero five three zero. My thumb knows it without thinking now.

text.id: Terus gue buka HP gue sendiri. Chat dengan nama dia. Setahun kosong.
text.en: Then I open my own phone. The chat with her name on it. A year of nothing.
I hold down the record button.

text.id: Kar. Aneh juga, ya, ngomong sendiri gini. HP lo mati, jadi ini nggak bakal nyampe.{w} Tapi lo ngajarin gue caranya.
text.en: Kar. This is stupid, talking to a phone that won't reach you, because yours is off.{w} But you taught me how.

text.id: Gue dateng. Telat setahun, telat satu jam. Gue nggak nemu lo. Tapi gue denger semuanya. Episode lo bagus. Semuanya.
text.en: I came. A year late, an hour late. I didn't find you. But I heard everything. Your episodes were good. All of them.

text.id: Sabtu, jam lima pagi. Dermaga Muara Angke. Gue tungguin sampai jam enam. Lewat jam enam juga.
text.en: Saturday, five in the morning. The Muara Angke pier. I'll wait till six. Past six, too.

text.id: Satu centang abu-abu. Terkirim. Nggak nyampe.
text.en: One grey tick. Sent. Not delivered.

text.id: Tiga hari kemudian, jam lima kurang dua pagi, centangnya jadi dua. Terus biru.
text.en: Three days later, at two minutes to five in the morning, the tick becomes two. Then blue.

text.id: Satu voice note masuk. Dua detik. Isinya cuma dua klik.{w} Gue aman. Lanjut rekam.
text.en: One voice note comes in. Two seconds. Nothing in it but two clicks.{w} I'm okay. Keep rolling.

summary.id: Raka tidak menemukan Sekar, tapi akhirnya menjawab voice note-nya. Tiga hari kemudian, pesannya terbaca, dan ada dua klik.
summary.en: Raka didn't find Sekar, but he finally answered her voice note. Three days later, his message was read, and there were two clicks.
